ops.sql: SELECT o.Object_ID, o.Name, o.Note FROM t_object o WHERE o.ea_guid = '{5762A4FA-2E12-4025-AF73-A0A3CB96681D}'
SELECT o.Object_ID, o.Name FROM t_object o WHERE o.Object_Type = 'Artifact' AND o.Name LIKE 'FB 20261011-B2%' ORDER BY o.Object_ID

SELECT o.Name, p.Property, p.Value FROM t_objectproperties p INNER JOIN t_object o ON o.Object_ID = p.Object_ID WHERE o.Object_Type = 'Artifact' AND o.Name LIKE 'FB 20261011-B2%' AND p.Property LIKE 'ai.baseline%' ORDER BY o.Object_ID
